description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to the setup and configuration of device pairing in the OpenClaw project, including URL resolution, security checks, and token handling.

methods.name: describeSecureMobilePairingFix
methods.description: Generates a message explaining how to fix insecure mobile pairing URLs.

methods.name: isPrivateLanHostname
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is a private LAN hostname.

methods.name: isPrivateLanIpHost
methods.description: Checks if a host is a private LAN IP address.

methods.name: isMobilePairingCleartextAllowedHost
methods.description: Determines if a host is allowed for mobile pairing over cleartext.

methods.name: validateMobilePairingUrl
methods.description: Validates a mobile pairing URL for security and correctness.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string, applying fallback schemes if necessary.

methods.name: resolveScheme
methods.description: Determines the URL scheme (ws or wss) based on configuration.

methods.name: pickIPv4Matching
methods.description: Selects an IPv4 address matching a given condition from network interfaces.

methods.name: pickLanIPv4
methods.description: Selects a LAN IPv4 address from network interfaces.

methods.name: pickTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Selects a Tailnet IPv4 address from network interfaces.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTokenFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway token from environment variables.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPasswordFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway password from environment variables.

methods.name: resolvePairingSetupAuthLabel
methods.description: Determines the authentication label (token or password) based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTokenSecretRef
methods.description: Resolves the gateway token secret reference, possibly fetching from secrets store.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPasswordSecretRef
methods.description: Resolves the gateway password secret reference, possibly fetching from secrets store.

methods.name: materializePairingSetupAuthConfig
methods.description: Combines token and password secret resolution into a complete auth config.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves the URL used for gateway communication, considering configuration and network state.

methods.name: encodePairingSetupCode
methods.description: Encodes pairing setup payload into a base64 string for transmission.

methods.name: resolvePairingSetupFromConfig
methods.description: Main function to resolve pairing setup information from configuration, including URL and token.
